# Capiflo

> Capiflo is a UK commercial finance broker, not a lender. We compare 120+ lenders to arrange
> business loans, asset finance, invoice finance, merchant cash advances, VAT loans and
> commercial mortgages for UK SMEs. All finance we arrange is unregulated business lending.

Capiflo arranges business finance for SMEs across the United Kingdom. Typical facilities range
from £5,000 to £500,000, with decisions in principle in as little as 60 minutes.

## Funding products

- [Business Loans](https://capiflo.co.uk/funding/business-loans): unsecured and secured SME loans
- [Asset Finance](https://capiflo.co.uk/funding/asset-finance): hire purchase and equipment leasing
- [Invoice Finance](https://capiflo.co.uk/funding/invoice-finance): factoring and invoice discounting
- [Merchant Cash Advance](https://capiflo.co.uk/funding/merchant-cash-advance): card-turnover-based advances
- [VAT Loans](https://capiflo.co.uk/funding/vat-loans): spread VAT bills over 3-12 months
- [Commercial Mortgages](https://capiflo.co.uk/funding/property-backed): owner-occupier and investment property
- [Start-up Loans](https://capiflo.co.uk/funding/start-up-loans): early-stage and new-business funding

## Tools and guides

- [Business finance calculators](https://capiflo.co.uk/calculators): repayment, borrowing power, product-specific calculators
- [Guides](https://capiflo.co.uk/guides): plain-English explainers on SME finance products and eligibility

## Coverage

- [Locations](https://capiflo.co.uk/locations): business finance across every UK county and 388 towns and cities
- [Sectors](https://capiflo.co.uk/sectors): sector-specific funding for construction, retail, hospitality, manufacturing and more
